specialist.en: The museum invited a specialist to examine the ancient painting.
specialist.zh: 博物館邀請一位專家檢查那幅古畫。

specialize.en: Some engineers specialize in designing energy-efficient buildings.
specialize.zh: 有些工程師專門設計節能建築。

specialty.en: Fresh bread is the bakery's most popular specialty.
specialty.zh: 新鮮麵包是這間麵包店最受歡迎的招牌。

stool.en: A wooden stool stood beside the art room table.
stool.zh: 美術教室桌旁放著一張木凳。

stop.en: The bus will stop beside the library after school.
stop.zh: 放學後，公車會停在圖書館旁。

storage.en: The school added more storage space for sports equipment.
storage.zh: 學校增加了更多運動器材的收納空間。

store.en: The small store near school sells notebooks and snacks.
store.zh: 學校附近的小店販售筆記本和點心。

storm.en: The storm passed overnight without damaging the school buildings.
storm.zh: 暴風雨在夜間通過，沒有損壞校舍。

stormy.en: The ferry was delayed because the sea became stormy.
stormy.zh: 海況變得風浪很大，因此渡輪延誤。

stove.en: A small stove warmed the cabin during the winter trip.
stove.zh: 冬季旅行時，一座小火爐讓小屋保持溫暖。

straight.en: Walk straight down the hall and turn left at the stairs.
straight.zh: 沿著走廊直走，到樓梯處左轉。

straighten.en: Please straighten the chairs before the meeting begins.
straighten.zh: 會議開始前請把椅子排整齊。

straightforward.en: The teacher gave a straightforward explanation of the new rule.
straightforward.zh: 老師對新規則做了簡單明確的說明。

strain.en: The long delay placed extra strain on the project schedule.
strain.zh: 漫長延誤讓專題時程承受更多壓力。

strait.en: The map shows a narrow strait between the two islands.
strait.zh: 地圖顯示兩座島之間有一條狹窄海峽。

strand.en: A single strand of thread hung from the sleeve.

strange.en: We heard a strange noise coming from the empty classroom.
strange.zh: 我們聽到空教室傳來奇怪的聲音。

stranger.en: The traveler asked a stranger for directions near the station.
stranger.zh: 旅客在車站附近向一位陌生人問路。

strap.en: She adjusted the backpack strap before starting the hike.
strap.zh: 她開始健行前調整了背包肩帶。

strategic.en: The team chose a strategic location for the information booth.
strategic.zh: 團隊為服務台選了一個有利的位置。

straw.en: The café provides a paper straw with each cold drink.
straw.zh: 咖啡館為每杯冷飲提供紙吸管。

strawberry.en: She added fresh strawberry slices to her breakfast yogurt.
strawberry.zh: 她把新鮮草莓片加進早餐優格。

stray.en: A stray dog rested beneath a tree near the park.
stray.zh: 一隻流浪狗在公園附近的樹下休息。

stream.en: A clear stream runs beside the mountain trail.
stream.zh: 一條清澈小溪沿著山徑流過。

street.en: The market fills the main street every Saturday morning.
street.zh: 每週六早上，市場會擺滿主要街道。

strength.en: Regular practice helped improve her strength and balance.
strength.zh: 規律練習幫助她提升力量和平衡感。

strengthen.en: Group projects can strengthen communication among classmates.
strengthen.zh: 小組專題可以增進同學之間的溝通。

stress.en: A clear schedule can reduce stress before major exams.
stress.zh: 清楚的時程可以減少大考前的壓力。

stretch.en: We took a short break to stretch after studying for an hour.
stretch.zh: 讀了一小時後，我們短暫休息伸展一下。

strict.en: The laboratory has strict rules about keeping work areas clean.
strict.zh: 實驗室對維持工作區整潔有嚴格規定。

stride.en: She crossed the stage with a confident stride.
stride.zh: 她以自信的步伐走過舞台。

strike.en: Workers may strike when negotiations fail to reach an agreement.
strike.zh: 談判無法達成協議時，勞工可能罷工。

striking.en: The painting has a striking contrast between light and shadow.
striking.zh: 這幅畫的明暗對比十分鮮明。

string.en: He tied the package with a piece of string.
string.zh: 他用一條細繩把包裹綁好。

strip.en: A narrow strip of land separates the road from the river.
strip.zh: 一條狹長土地把道路和河流隔開。

stripe.en: Each team shirt has a blue stripe across the front.
stripe.zh: 每件隊服正面都有一道藍色條紋。

strive.en: Students should strive to improve rather than compare themselves with others.
strive.zh: 學生應努力進步，而不是一直和別人比較。

stroll.en: We took a quiet stroll around the lake after lunch.
stroll.zh: 午餐後，我們悠閒地繞湖散步。

structural.en: Engineers found a structural problem in the old bridge.
structural.zh: 工程師在舊橋上發現結構問題。

struggle.en: Many students struggle at first when learning a new skill.
struggle.zh: 許多學生剛開始學新技能時會感到吃力。

stubborn.en: The stain was stubborn and remained after several washes.
stubborn.zh: 那個污漬很頑固，洗了好幾次仍留著。

studio.en: The art club meets in a bright studio after school.
studio.zh: 美術社放學後在一間明亮的工作室聚會。

stuff.en: Please put your stuff in the locker before class begins.
stuff.zh: 上課前請把你的東西放進置物櫃。

stumble.en: He began to stumble over difficult words during the speech.
stumble.zh: 演講時，他開始在較難的字上說得不順。

sturdy.en: The new desk is sturdy enough to hold several heavy books.
sturdy.zh: 新書桌很堅固，可以放好幾本厚重的書。

style.en: Her writing style became clearer after several rounds of revision.
style.zh: 經過多次修改後，她的寫作風格變得更清楚。

subjective.en: The review is partly subjective because it reflects personal taste.
subjective.zh: 這篇評論有部分主觀，因為反映個人喜好。

submarine.en: The museum displays a model submarine in its naval history section.
submarine.zh: 博物館的海軍歷史展區展示了一艘潛水艇模型。

subscribe.en: Students can subscribe to the school newsletter by email.
subscribe.zh: 學生可以透過電子郵件訂閱校刊。

subscription.en: The library renewed its digital magazine subscription this month.
subscription.zh: 圖書館這個月續訂了數位雜誌。
